raw.reasoning: The failed run showed vitest in packages/sdk importing missing execa. Aligning sdk with workspace Vitest 4 removes that broken dependency path and passes clean npm ci + sdk tests.

retrospective.summary: Resolved PR #45 CI failure in @relaycast/sdk by updating vitest to ^4.0.18 and refreshing package-lock.json to remove the stale sdk-local vitest@1 tree that required missing execa.
